consoleId.description: ID of the console to proxy requests to

consoleIP.description: IP address of the console on the local network

get.description: Returns the project state for external integrations including shapes, plans, products, wall types, and attenuation object types. Use the mode query parameter for 2D or 3D representations.

oneOf.title: Calibration
oneOf.description: Camera-to-floor-plan calibration for a Protect device. `position` is four footprint corners in map-local meters. `videoPosition` is the matching corners on the camera image in normalized 0-1 coordinates (origin top-left).

shapes.description: Map, device, scale, wall, calibration and attenuation-object shapes in the project.

products.description: Devices placed in the project with their fingerprint data.

get.description: Returns floor plans for RF planning import including image URLs, scale (pixels per meter), and coordinate origin. Optionally filter by `siteId`.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

schema.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

image_url.description: Floor plan image path at `/proxy/innerspace/integration/v1/assets/{planId}/{filename}`. Requires the same session auth headers as this endpoint. Prepend the API origin (e.g. api.ui.com connector prefix) to fetch.

ppm.description: Pixels per meter (`ppm`). Required to interpret coordinates and heights.

width.description: Floor plan image width in pixels. Omitted when unknown.

height.description: Floor plan image height in pixels. Omitted when unknown.

origin_x.description: X coordinate of the floor plan origin in pixels (0 when coordinates use top-left image origin).

origin_y.description: Y coordinate of the floor plan origin in pixels (0 when coordinates use top-left image origin).

site_id.description: UniFi site ID when `siteId` query filter is applied.

get.description: Returns placed UniFi access points with position, orientation, mounting details, and status. Optionally filter by `siteId`.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

schema.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

serial.description: Device identifier for Hamina import. Uses the MAC address without colons, prefixed with `SN`.

x.description: X coordinate on the floor plan image in pixels.

y.description: Y coordinate on the floor plan image in pixels.

height.description: Mounting height in meters above the floor.

azimuth.description: Antenna orientation in degrees (0–360), derived from device rotation.

get.description: Returns placed UniFi switches with position and status. Optionally filter by `siteId`.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

schema.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

serial.description: Device identifier for Hamina import. Uses the MAC address without colons, prefixed with `SN`.

get.description: Returns managed access points and switches that are not placed on any floor plan. Optionally filter by `siteId`.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

schema.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

serial.description: Device identifier for Hamina import. Uses the MAC address without colons, prefixed with `SN`.

devices.description: Managed access points and switches not placed on any floor plan.
